description: BaoCut: an AI video agent with an editable timeline. Transcribe, subtitle, translate, dub, cut and animate.
summary: BaoCut is a video editor where the agent works through a CLI and MCP command catalog and the result stays as a live, editable timeline instead of a one-shot MP4, so fixing one subtitle line or swapping one shot doesn't mean re-running the whole pipeline. The skill-install pattern—drop a manual into `~/.claude/skills` so any agent knows how to drive the tool—is essentially the same architecture I use in AgentOn Pocket and PenguPool to expose capabilities to Claude and Codex, just pointed at ffmpeg, Whisper, and HTDemucs instead of code. What sells it to me is the local-first stack combined with the "honest delivery" contract: the agent reports which frames it actually inspected and what still needs a human ear, which is the trust model I expect from any tool I let run autonomously on my machine.
